description: This file defines synchronization primitives such as CriticalSection, BinairySemaphore, CountingSemaphore, and Event, along with related utility classes and functions, for use within the WPEFramework Core namespace. It includes platform-specific implementations for Linux and Windows, and provides mechanisms for thread synchronization and interlocked operations.

classes.name: CriticalSection
classes.description: A class providing mutual exclusion mechanisms, with platform-specific implementations for Linux and Windows.

classes.name: BinairySemaphore
classes.description: A semaphore allowing binary (locked/unlocked) states, with platform-specific implementations.

classes.name: CountingSemaphore
classes.description: A semaphore that manages a count, supporting multiple concurrent locks, with platform-specific implementations.

classes.name: Event
classes.description: A synchronization event object supporting manual or automatic reset, platform-specific.

methods.name: CriticalSection::Lock
methods.description: Locks the critical section, platform-specific implementation.

methods.name: CriticalSection::Unlock
methods.description: Unlocks the critical section, platform-specific implementation.

methods.name: BinairySemaphore::BinairySemaphore
methods.description: Constructor for BinairySemaphore, initializes semaphore state.

methods.name: CountingSemaphore::CountingSemaphore
methods.description: Constructor for CountingSemaphore, initializes count limits.

methods.name: CountingSemaphore::Unlock
methods.description: Unlocks the semaphore, increasing the count.

methods.name: Event::Event
methods.description: Constructor for Event object, sets initial state.

methods.name: Event::Lock
methods.description: Waits for the event to be signaled.

methods.name: InterlockedIncrement
methods.description: Performs an atomic increment on a 32-bit unsigned integer.

methods.name: InterlockedDecrement
methods.description: Performs an atomic decrement on a 32-bit unsigned integer.
